meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可按你要求生成《Journey Into [项目名]》叙事报告：从 claude-mem 记忆时间线取全部开发记录，分析起源、架构、突破、技术债等，并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你说“写时间线报告”“分析项目历史”或直接点名“Journey into [项目名]”等请求时触发；前提是 claude-mem 后台服务在运行，且该项目已有记忆观测记录。

say.text: 写一份 Journey into tokyo 的时间线报告
say.note: Claude 会读取该项目完整历史并生成报告。

say.text: 分析一下我当前项目的开发历史
say.note: 会先确认项目名，再生成 Journey 报告。

say.text: 给这个项目出一份完整开发历程报告
say.note: 需要 claude-mem 服务正在运行。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude pulls a project's full timeline from claude-mem and writes a 'Journey Into [Project]' narrative report (genesis, architecture, breakthroughs, work patterns, debt, challenges, stats), saved as Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests like 'timeline report', 'Journey into [project]', or 'project history analysis'. Requires the claude-mem worker to be running and recorded observations for that project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey into tokyo timeline report
say_en.note: Claude will fetch tokyo's full history and generate the report.

say_en.text: Analyze the development history of my current project
say_en.note: It will confirm the project name, then create the report.

say_en.text: Produce a full development journey report for this project
say_en.note: Requires the claude-mem service to be running.
